sentences.text: 十一、十二、十三、十四、十五！
十六、十七、十八、十九、二十！
三十、四十、五十、六十、七十、八十、九十、一百！
sentences.gloss: Thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, a hundred!
He is eighteen and she is nineteen.

sentences.text: 那个男人四十岁，那个女人三十岁。
sentences.gloss: That man is forty, that woman is thirty.

sentences.text: 那个人八十岁，不是九十岁。
sentences.gloss: That person is eighty, not ninety.
He is a hundred and one!
All these thousand books are here.
Those two children are over there.
Those two tables are over there.
Those six beds are over there.
There are a lot of people here.
It’s crowded here and quiet over there.
There are very few people here.
There are many students but not many teachers.

sentences.text: 有些人在这里，有些人在那里。
sentences.gloss: Some people are here, some are over there.

sentences.text: 一些书在这里，一些书在那里。
sentences.gloss: Some books are here, some are over there.

sentences.text: 这一千多个学生都在这里。
sentences.gloss: All these thousand-odd students are here.

sentences.text: 他有三个孩子：两个儿子和一个女儿。
sentences.gloss: He has three children: two sons and a daughter.

sentences.text: 我家有四口人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥和我。
sentences.gloss: There are four of us in my family: dad, mum, my elder brother and me.
alts: 我们家有四口人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥和我。

sentences.gloss: There are five people in our family.
Grandma (my mother’s mother) has two granddaughters.
My elder sister has a son.

sentences.text: 我叔叔有一个儿子和两个女儿。
sentences.gloss: My uncle (my father’s younger brother) has a son and two daughters.
I have three older cousins (sons of my father’s brothers).

sentences.text: 我有一个表姐和两个表弟。
sentences.gloss: I have an older female cousin and two younger male cousins.
My uncle (my mother’s brother) has two children.
I have a lot of books.
My uncle (my father’s elder brother) has two granddaughters.

sentences.text: 我有一个侄子和两个侄女。
sentences.gloss: I have a nephew and two nieces (my brother’s children).

sentences.text: 这是我爸爸，那是我妈妈。
sentences.gloss: This is my dad, that is my mum.
alts: 那是我妈妈，这是我爸爸。

sentences.gloss: My elder brother is a teacher.

sentences.text: 我爸爸五十岁，我妈妈四十八岁。
sentences.gloss: My father is fifty and my mother forty-eight.
This is my aunt (the wife of my father’s elder brother).
My uncle and aunt (my mother’s brother and his wife) are here.

sentences.text: 我姑姑和姑父都是老师。
sentences.gloss: My aunt (my father’s sister) and her husband are both teachers.

sentences.text: 他是我表哥，不是我哥哥。
sentences.gloss: He is my cousin, not my brother.
She is my younger cousin (my father’s brother’s daughter).

sentences.text: 这是我侄子，那是我外甥。
sentences.gloss: This is my nephew (my brother’s son), that is my nephew (my sister’s son).
He is a relative of mine.

sentences.text: 我爷爷和外公都是老师。
alts: 我外公和爷爷都是老师。

sentences.text: 这是我奶奶，那是我外婆。
sentences.gloss: This is my grandmother on my father’s side, that is my grandmother on my mother’s side.
That baby is my grandson (my daughter’s son).
This is my granddaughter (my son’s daughter).
My uncle and aunt (my father’s younger brother and his wife) are over there.
My uncle (my father’s elder brother) is sixty.
Auntie is my mother’s younger sister.

sentences.text: 我姨父和阿姨都在这里。
sentences.gloss: My uncle and aunt (my mother’s sister and her husband) are both here.

sentences.text: 我的侄女五岁，我的外甥女三岁。
sentences.gloss: My niece (brother’s daughter) is five, my niece (sister’s daughter) is three.
alts: 我侄女五岁，我外甥女三岁。

sentences.text: 我的弟弟和妹妹都是学生。
sentences.gloss: My younger brother and sister are both students.
alts: 我弟弟和妹妹都是学生。

sentences.text: 那是我堂姐，这是我表妹。
sentences.gloss: That is my older cousin (father’s side), this is my younger cousin (mother’s side).
My younger cousin (my father’s brother’s son) is eighteen.

sentences.text: 这些孩子都是我的孙子。
sentences.gloss: These children are all my grandsons.

sentences.text: 这是她的家，不是我的家。
sentences.gloss: This is her home, not mine.
